commit.message:
chore(release): raise the version to 0.5.8, build 99

Client version 0.58 ("0.5.8"), build 99, dated 2026-10-06, and
version.txt to match, so a 0.5.4 to 0.5.7 install sees an update to
test the rebuilt updater with. changes.txt gains the 0.5.8 entry for
the updater. The server's minimum client version stays 0.57: nothing
in the protocol changed.

Rebuild the client executable with C:/nvgt/nvgt.exe -c; it was not
rebuilt here, so the tracked Infinite Warfare.exe is still older.
